scripts.build: pnpm generate:og-assets && next build && node tools/site/generate-og-assets.ts --check
scripts.check: pnpm data:check && pnpm check:i18n && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm lint:next && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:tools
scripts.lint: oxlint src e2e next.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs -c ./.oxlintrc.json && node tools/site/check-boundaries.ts
scripts.lint:next: eslint src e2e next.config.ts playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format: oxfmt src e2e docs AGENTS.md README.md DESIGN.md --write --ignore-path ./.oxfmtignore
scripts.format:check: oxfmt src e2e docs AGENTS.md README.md DESIGN.md --check --ignore-path ./.oxfmtignore
scripts.docs:check: pnpm pro-gov doctor && pnpm doc-gov router-check && pnpm doc-gov check && pnpm doc-gov scan --check && pnpm doc-gov links && pnpm doc-gov audit && pnpm doc-gov doctor
scripts.check:i18n: swimmer-i18n-check check && swimmer-i18n-check types --out src/i18n/message-contracts.ts --check && node tools/site/check-messages.ts
